summary: Awesome Oscillator histogram: 5-bar minus 34-bar simple average of median price, green when rising and red when falling.
overview: The Awesome Oscillator shows momentum as a histogram in its own pane, around a zero line. Bars are green when the value is higher than on the previous bar and red when lower or equal.
It was created by Bill Williams to compare recent momentum with a longer view.
how: AO = SMA(median price, 5) - SMA(median price, 34), where median price = (high + low) / 2.
Above zero, the short-term average is above the long-term one; below zero, it is under it.
use: Some traders watch zero-line crosses as a sign of a change in momentum.
Look at the color sequence: a run of green bars shows momentum building.
Some traders look for a saucer pattern: three bars that dip and turn on the same side of zero.
Compare two peaks on the same side of zero with price peaks to look for divergence.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
The 5 and 34 lengths are fixed in the classic formula.
